import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AAS="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
MAT=np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()] for r in B62.split("\n")],float); IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAS)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s])
def nwali(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    a=enc(s1);b=enc(s2);n,m=len(a),len(b);NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Pm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);Px=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);Py=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0;Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);Px[1:,0]=1;Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);Py[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        row=MAT[a[i-1],b];st=np.vstack([Mx[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]])
        k=st.argmax(0);Mx[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(m)]+row;Pm[i,1:]=k
        c0=Mx[i-1,1:]+go;c1=Ix[i-1,1:]+ge;kk=c1>c0;Ix[i,1:]=np.where(kk,c1,c0);Px[i,1:]=np.where(kk,1,0)
        Mi=Mx[i];Iyi=Iy[i];Pyi=Py[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            x0=Mi[j-1]+go;x1=Iyi[j-1]+ge
            if x1>x0: Iyi[j]=x1;Pyi[j]=2
            else: Iyi[j]=x0;Pyi[j]=0
    i,j=n,m;stt=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));pos1=[];ident=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if stt==0 and i>0 and j>0: pos1.append(i);ident.append(s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]);stt=Pm[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif stt==1 and i>0: pos1.append(i);ident.append(False);stt=Px[i,j];i-=1
        elif stt==2 and j>0: stt=Py[i,j];j-=1
        elif i>0: pos1.append(i);ident.append(False);i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pd.DataFrame(dict(pos=list(reversed(pos1)),ident=list(reversed(ident))))
def useq(acc): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
S={"KLP11":useq("Q19633"),"KLP20":useq("Q965T6"),"KIF3B":useq("O15066"),"KIF3A":useq("Q9Y496")}
d_worm=nwali(S["KLP11"],S["KLP20"]); d_vert=nwali(S["KIF3B"],S["KIF3A"])
def roll(d,w=25):
    s=d.set_index("pos").ident.astype(float).rolling(w,center=True,min_periods=5).mean()*100
    return s
rw=roll(d_worm); rv=roll(d_vert)
# region table
regions_w=[("motor domain",11,351),("neck linker + neck coil",352,405),("stalk CC1",409,501),
           ("CC2 / PF32951 trigger",506,592),("tail (KAP-1 interface)",640,722),("distal tail",723,782)]
regions_v=[("motor domain",7,348),("neck linker + neck coil",349,386),("acidic insert",387,408),
           ("stalk CC1",409,524),("CC2 / PF32951 trigger",529,617),("tail (KAP3 interface)",639,700),("distal tail",701,747)]
rows=[]
for nm,a,b in regions_w:
    sub=d_worm[(d_worm.pos>=a)&(d_worm.pos<=b)]
    rows.append(dict(pair="KLP-11 vs KLP-20", region=nm, span=f"{a}-{b}", n=len(sub), pct_identity=round(100*sub.ident.mean(),1)))
for nm,a,b in regions_v:
    sub=d_vert[(d_vert.pos>=a)&(d_vert.pos<=b)]
    rows.append(dict(pair="KIF3B vs KIF3A", region=nm, span=f"{a}-{b}", n=len(sub), pct_identity=round(100*sub.ident.mean(),1)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(T.to_string(index=False))
print("\nNeck linker core motif:")
print("  KLP-11 331-347:", S["KLP11"][330:347])
print("  KLP-20 319-335:", S["KLP20"][318:335])
print("  KIF3B  328-344:", S["KIF3B"][327:344])
print("  KIF3A  333-349:", S["KIF3A"][332:349])
print("\nC-terminal tail lengths beyond the PF32951 domain:")
for lab,s,dom_end in [("KLP-11",S["KLP11"],592),("KLP-20",S["KLP20"],584),("KIF3B",S["KIF3B"],617),("KIF3A",S["KIF3A"],622)]:
    print(f"  {lab}: total {len(s)}, tail beyond PF32951 = {len(s)-dom_end} residues")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4.6))
ax.plot(rw.index,rw.values,lw=1.4,color="#2F6FC2",label="KLP-11 vs KLP-20 (C. elegans)")
ax.plot(rv.index,rv.values,lw=1.4,color="#C2512F",label="KIF3B vs KIF3A (human)")
for a,b,c,lab in [(11,351,"#B9C6D9","motor"),(352,405,"#F0C06A","neck linker + neck coil"),
                  (506,592,"#7FB287","CC2 / PF32951"),(640,722,"#E5B8CC","tail (KAP interface)")]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.35); ax.text((a+b)/2,96,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.axhline(d_worm.ident.mean()*100,ls=":",color="#2F6FC2",lw=1)
ax.axhline(d_vert.ident.mean()*100,ls=":",color="#C2512F",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("KLP-11 (blue) / KIF3B (red) residue number",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("paralog identity, 25-residue window (%)",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Where the two kinesin-II motor subunits differ: the neck linker is the most similar non-motor element,\n"
             "the tail is the most divergent, in both the worm and the human pair",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
